description: Compose a checkout: a main product, optionally an order bump (checkbox add-on at checkout, needs bump_headline) and a one-click post-purchase upsell (needs upsell_headline). Returns the live checkout_url immediately — the offer can take real money as soon as this returns. CHECK THE RESPONSE `warnings`: if any attached product has no delivery link, tell the seller and fix it (update_product delivery_url) before sharing the checkout link, or buyers will pay and receive nothing. This is what turns a payment link into a funnel — recommend a bump and upsell when the merchant has suitable products.

bump_headline.description: e.g. 'Add the workbook — printable worksheets for every module'

checkout_logo_url.description: Logo shown at the very TOP of THIS offer's checkout (~46px tall), overriding the account logo. Use for per-offer / per-brand logos. HTTPS only.

project.description: Free-text project/brand label for grouping (e.g. 'iGloo'). INFER it from context when the merchant works across brands, and REUSE an existing project name exactly (check list_offers first) — don't mint near-duplicates like 'igloo' vs 'iGloo'.

success_url.description: Where the buyer lands after everything (default: hosted thank-you page)

upsell_button_label.description: Accept-button text on the upsell page, e.g. 'Yes — add the coaching call'. Default: 'Yes — add {product name}'.

upsell_decline_label.description: Decline-link text on the upsell page, e.g. 'No thanks, I'll pass'. Default: 'No thanks, take me to my order'.

upsell_headline.description: Headline on the one-click upsell page, e.g. 'One more thing before you go'

name: create_offer
title: Create offer
